notes: Identifier resolution took three steps, recorded because the first two failed. An OpenAlex keyword search for the title returned only W7118242312, an ETH Zurich Research Collection deposit with doi 10.3929/ethz-c-000791492 and no arXiv location; that is a repository DOI for a conference object, not a publisher DOI, and it is deliberately not recorded as the entry's doi. A regex scrape of the arXiv keyword search page returned nothing. The exact title in quotes on the arXiv web search interface (https://arxiv.org/search/?searchtype=all&query=%22Topology-Agnostic+Foundation+Model+for+EEG%22) returned exactly one result, arXiv:2510.22257, which the abs page confirms as this paper (v1, 25 Oct 2025; comments field 'NeurIPS camera-ready version, 27 pages, 10 figures, 13 tables'). This matches the pattern flagged in _briefs/collection-practice.md: keyword search misses recent preprints that exact-title search finds. No publisher DOI exists for the NeurIPS proceedings version, so doi is null and the arXiv abs page is canonical. Author list read from the PDF title block: Berkay Doner, Thorir Mar Ingolfsson, Luca Benini, Yawei Li, all at the Integrated Systems Laboratory, ETH Zurich; the asterisk on Ingolfsson marks correspondence, not equal contribution. LICENCE -- the abs-license block links http://arxiv.org/licenses/nonexclusive-distrib/1.0/, arXiv's default grant, which runs to arXiv rather than to third parties, so it is not a Creative Commons licence and the preprint-cc-arxiv token does not apply. Deny by default: licence unknown, redistribution_ok false, no committed PDF. The v1 PDF is cached as source.local.pdf, which is gitignored and never committed, and source.md was generated from it; source.md is retained as internal research notes under fair use, on the same footing as a paywalled paper's extraction. EXTRACTION -- pymupdf4llm, per _briefs/collection-practice.md; markitdown was not used. This is a single-column NeurIPS preprint and converts cleanly: running prose, Tables 1-3 (the three results tables), Tables 5-8 (hyperparameters and complexity) and Table 11 (pretraining and downstream dataset summary) are all faithful with word spacing and column alignment preserved, hence md_quality: clean. Known gaps: the equations in Sections 3.1-3.3 are dropped, and Figures 1-9 render as image placeholders, so the FLOPs and memory scaling curves in Figure 2 and the query attention maps in Figures 4 and 9 are unavailable in text form. No number quoted on the card comes from a figure. The NeurIPS paper checklist is included in the extraction and is the source for the statement that weights are not yet released.
